review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped the Feige directory for uses of expWeight, fPlus, fMinus, uIntegral and vIntegral. The file declares no @[simp] lemmas and no simp-set attributes. The definitions are unfolded by hand with `unfold` and `rw [fPlus, fMinus]`, and nothing outside this file uses them. So I found no downstream simp goal where a missing lemma, wrong orientation, competing rule, unwanted expansion or rewrite cycle shows up. The only simp-related spot is `simpa [mul_comm] using h` in four_point_exponential_shifts. It is local and bounded, because simp orders `mul_comm` rewrites, so it is not a credible loop. I considered adding simp or unfolding lemmas such as `expWeight_def` or an `ofReal (exp ..)` normal form. I did not report them, because the rubric warns against recommending simp annotations only because an identity looks simple, and I saw no concrete use that needs them.
